Nineteen comments

Origin of this tune

This reel was written by fiddle Jenna Moynihan.

I did the transcrption to ABC based on Jenna’s own performance on youtube here :

http://youtu.be/Aure1RooISk

The tune can also be found here performed by Ampersand (Katie Davis Henderson on fiddle and Liz Davis Maxfield on cello) :

http://youtu.be/MQFimW9W7OU

The A part is F# minor, the B part is its relative, A major.

A really great tune, I hope you’ll like it.
